_comment: Governance trust root for the Awaaz ASR training runtime. Tracked in the repository
and located by runtime.GOVERNANCE_PUBLIC_KEYS_PATH -- never by an environment
variable and never by a command-line argument.
PUBLIC HALVES ONLY. A private Ed25519 key must never appear in this repository, on a
training host, or in any backup that a training operator can reach.
This file ships EMPTY. With no key pinned, the runtime refuses every real command with
governance_trust_root_missing, which is the correct state until a clinical owner
exists. Adding a key here is a governance act, not a configuration change: whoever can
run training must not be the person who commits the key, or the approval boundary this
file exists to create is defeated. See docs/GOVERNANCE_KEYS.md for the procedure.
Entry shape (all fields required, all strings):
key_id      stable label, [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}, signed inside the receipt
public_key  raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, lowercase hex, 64 characters
not_before  timezone-aware ISO-8601 instant the key becomes usable
not_after   timezone-aware ISO-8601 instant the key stops being usable
holder      named accountable human and role, e.g. "Dr A. N. Other, stroke neurologist"
A malformed entry fails the whole file closed; it is never skipped.
